archetypes.name: dyn-release-flag
archetypes.rationale: Release prompt flag parsing changed and needs behavior-focused review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /release flag rename in the changed skill and docs. Focus on whether --skip-approve/-s is the only accepted auto-confirm flag, whether --approve/-a fail closed before release prepare, and whether PR_COUNT=0 still reaches the default-Cancel confirmation prompt. Check that public docs and skill frontmatter stay aligned. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
